newsitem.title: SYRIA: Radicala vow to continue fight against Israel.
newsitem.headline: Radicala vow to continue fight against Israel.

text.p: Radical Palestinian groups have commemorated the assassination of Islamic Jihad leader Fathi Shqaqi with a vow to continue the fight against Israel.
A statement issued on Thursday by the 10-member alliance, of which Shqaqi was a member, praised the Jihad leader as a "freedom fighter."
"The alliance pledges to the Palestinian, Arab and Islamic masses that it will continue to fight Israel until the liberation of Palestine from the Zionists," the statement said.
Shqaqi was gunned down last October 26 in Malta. His assassins were never found but Israel's Mossad secret service is widely believed to be behind the killing.
The alliance is opposed to the Palestinian-Israeli peace deal that gave Palestinians limited self-rule in parts of the West Bank and Gaza strip. It has vowed to wreck the accord.
The militant Islamic Jihad claimed responsibility for several suicide attacks which killed scores of people in Israel since the deal was signed in 1993.
Israel went on high security alert on Wednesday ahead of the anniversary fearing guerrilla vengeance attacks.
